source: The 2026-11-18 navego.pages.dev rebrand and consistency pass: logo, wordmark, eyebrows, type and spacing system, nav notch, copy pass. User direction arrived 2026-11-18; internet sources were verified 2026-11-18. Repo sources point at the docs that already carry the decision. 2026-11-19: a source-backed pass over the agent tool surface added D55-D68 - kind recorded carries the file:line of the recorded performance, per the user evidence mandate.
note: One decision, one source. Code references this file as decisions.json -> D<n>. A decision the user asked for carries kind=user; a decision nobody asked for carries the internet source it was taken from; a decision inherited from this repo carries the repo document that already carries it; a decision taken because a recorded performance demanded it carries kind=recorded with the file:line that records it.

decisions.decision: The body text is 14 px on every page.

source.also: https://email.digital.nsw.gov.au/styles/typography/line-height (body-sm 14 px)

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'jika misalnya heading 1 heading 2 dan seterusnya gunakan ukuran genap dan konsisten'
source.also: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (4dp nested units)

source.ref: user 2026-11-18 (even-size rule)
source.also: https://design-system.canada.ca/en/styles/typography (heading levels, numerically ordered)

decisions.decision: Line heights are unitless: display 1.1, heading 1.25, body 1.5, small 1.4.

source.ref: https://practicaltypography.com/line-spacing.html (120-145% of point size)
source.also: https://designsystem.digital.gov/components/typography/ (line-height 4 token, body 1.5); https://email.digital.nsw.gov.au/styles/typography/line-height (body 1.5, small 1.33-1.43); https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/line-height (prefer unitless)

decisions.decision: Running text meets the 1.5 line-height floor so it survives visitor overrides.

source.ref: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/text-spacing.html (criterion 1.4.12, AA)

decisions.decision: Text fills the width of its container; no 18ch/44ch/46ch/66ch/68ch/72ch measure caps anywhere.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'lebarnya full bukan yang terpotong di tengah' and the follow-up option 'Konten tidak dibatasi terlalu sempit'

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: 'alignment mana yang harus alignment kiri mana yang harus tengah semua harus konsisten'

source.ref: https://practicaltypography.com/space-between-paragraphs.html (50-100% of the point size)

decisions.decision: A heading gets more space above (32 px, larger than paragraph spacing, so it stands out) and less below (12 px, smaller than paragraph spacing, so it bonds to its text).

source.ref: https://practicaltypography.com/space-above-and-below.html

decisions.decision: The spacing scale is multiples of 4 px: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 72, 104.

source.ref: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (8dp grid, 4dp nested units, 4dp type baseline)

decisions.decision: The gutter is 20 px, 32 px at ≥940 px — one fixed even step each, no fractional vw.

source.ref: https://material.io/design/layout/spacing-methods.html (4-px base unit, both values sit on the grid)

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: "notchnya masih belum betul aku mau buat jadi minimalis tanpa lekukan"

decisions.decision: One idea per tile, headline of 2-6 words; the supporting line is one sentence; nothing advertises more than one benefit at a time.

source.ref: https://www.apple.com (product tiles: one idea per headline); https://developer.apple.com/app-store/product-page/ (concise informative paragraph); https://marketingexamined.com/blog/how-to-write-copy-like-apple (one big idea per headline; inverted pyramid)

decisions.decision: Sentences average ten to fourteen words; the longest sentence on any page stays under twenty-five; shorter lines carry the same meaning with no orphan clauses.

source.ref: https://yourtechnicalcopywriter.com/copywriting-tips-from-apple (average sentence length of iPhone 5 copy: 10.9, 11.9, 14.0 words); https://marketingexamined.com/blog/how-to-write-copy-like-apple (write for scanners)

decisions.decision: Address the reader in the second person, in the present tense, with verbs that are things the product literally does (read, fill, click, save); no adjectives praising the product, no exclamation marks.

source.ref: https://help.apple.com/pdf/applestyleguide/en_US/apple-style-guide.pdf (Apple style guide: sentence-style headings, second person, active voice); https://developer.apple.com/videos/play/wwdc2022/10037/ (write like a person, one idea at a time)

decisions.decision: Facts pinned by the site gate survive any rewrite verbatim: Navego, 45, primitive browser, plan.usd-1, PayPal, Enterprise, SHA-256, 1.6.22, docs/releases, browser_status, debugger, Tanpa eval, Kata sandi, SECURITY.md, Diukur bukan diklaim, Google Docs, p50, Apa itu Navego, Berapa harganya, Halaman ini tidak ada, browser Anda, Penyedia, Izin aplikasi, Memeriksa sesi, WebDriver, canvas, Artikel, AI yang mengenal browser, Dukungan, Kebijakan Privasi, Syarat Layanan.

source.ref: tests/site/site.test.ts (CLAIMS); site/app/routes/*.tsx

decisions.decision: The site is written in Indonesian, like the UI it describes; technical terms the product itself uses (browser, MCP, extension, plan, PayPal) stay in English only when the interface shows them in English.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: redesign the site content with internet research for sentence style; product language stayed Indonesian (lang="id" across every route, site.test.ts)

decisions.decision: Inverted pyramid in every section: the claim first, the strongest proof second, the rest last - readers who stop after one line still leave with the right idea.

source.ref: https://marketingexamined.com/blog/how-to-write-copy-like-apple (big headlines showcase one idea, inverted-pyramid paragraphs: biggest benefit to smallest); https://linear.app (claim, then proof, then link)

decisions.decision: The coba section ships the product UI itself: a navy command panel (prompt, typed text, caret, preset chips) and a paper trace panel (numbered primitive steps, always visible) - no submit button hiding the interesting half; the interaction lives in the choice of preset, not in a form submit.

source.ref: https://www.apple.com (product demos ship the interface as the marketing); https://linear.app (the product UI as the marketing); https://www.raycast.com/ (typewriter prompt panel as the hero)

decisions.decision: The chevron panel never repeats what the bar already shows: above 940px it lists only the secondary links (Keamanan, Changelog, FAQ, Metodologi, Bandingkan, Privasi, Syarat); at or below 940px, where the primary row is hidden, it lists every link, five per column in menu order.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: "ini masih dobel kenapa yak" - the panel repeated the eight links already visible in the bar; user wants no duplicate

decisions.decision: The header carries only the brand and one amber CTA; the flat nav row and the mega panel are deleted; the chevron is the only navigation surface, opening the full fifteen-link panel at every width.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18: "Hilangkan bar nav atas" - the flat Beranda..Dukungan row was still displayed on top, duplicating what the chevron panel already carries

decisions.decision: The chevron panel is a full-width dark mega panel in four columns - Beranda spotlight, Produk, Kepercayaan then Sumber, Bantuan - the Apple Shop-menu pattern the owner sent, so a visitor knows the site structure from the dropdown alone; the header row is full-bleed edge-to-edge, not capped to the 1120px content measure.

source.ref: user 2026-11-18 screenshot of apple.com Shop dropdown; user instruction: "punya headernya efek memanjang terus full dari pojok ke pojok kemudian redesign lagi kontn panel drop yang beranda dan seterusnya supaya orang tidak bingung lihatnya"

decisions.decision: No divider between the bar and the mega panel - one continuous dark surface; the panel fades and rises slowly (450ms opacity / 500ms rise) over the ease-out, instant during reduced motion; the stuck-state shadow under the bar is removed so the bar reads as one surface with the panel, not a floating plane above it. The seam the shadow left behind is closed twice: the full-width chevron wrapper carries the bar's navy-deep background so the cream ground never shows through at the bottom edge, and the open strip overlaps the seam by 1px (margin-top: -1px).

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "buat animasinya lebih slow dan hilangkan garis strip yang ada di bawah chevron buat supaya nav bar seperti ke bawah memanjang" - the shadow was the 1px line passing below the chevron

decisions.decision: The bar carries the brand on the left, "Beranda" as a plain text link beside it, and two actions on the right: "Masuk" (ghost, links to the sign-in page) and "Pasang gratis" (solid amber CTA) - the owner reported both missing.

decisions.decision: browser_read_page gains a bound on how much it returns (maxChars, and a selector scope or a view-style brief/map split in the implementation); an agent is expected to read a bounded page, never an unbounded one.

source.ref: docs/releases/1.6.47.md:8-19 - view brief (default, one viewport at a time) vs view map (the whole document) existed; read_page_map was folded into read_page and the tool count was asserted in CI as a frozen inventory
source.also: https://www.anthropic.com/research/writing-tools-for-agents - pagination, range selection, filtering and truncation for tool responses; the 25,000-token default; redundant tool calls suggest rightsizing pagination or token limits

decisions.decision: The tool lists in local/README.md and docs/agent-call.md are regenerated from the catalog instead of handwritten; the tool count is asserted in CI the way 1.6.47 and 1.6.48 asserted it; every recipe in browser_get_guide resolves to a live tool name.

source.ref: docs/agent-call.md:59 claims 56 tools; local/README.md:79-93 lists the generation-1 agent-native names; 1.6.52.md:12, 1.6.53.md:16, 1.6.54.md:16 say 56 unchanged; 1.6.57.md is a 0-byte file; live catalog 2026-11-19 has 45 browser_-prefixed tools; npm registry opera-agent-mcp 1.7.5 (modified 2026-11-17) vs package.json 1.6.54; docs/proof/extension-run.jsonl recorded toolCount 54 on 2026-11-06

decisions.decision: artifact_build_workbook and artifact_build_report ship as one tool with a format parameter (word or xlsx); the signed parameters are identical (client, title, period, periodColumn, groupBy, valueColumn, out) and both run the same plan recheck before the file exists.

source.ref: catalog signatures of 2026-11-19, verbatim: both tools carry client, title, period, periodColumn?, groupBy, valueColumn, out? and refuse the same wrong figure twice
source.also: https://www.anthropic.com/research/writing-tools-for-agents - too many or overlapping tools distract agents from efficient strategies; consolidate functionality into tools with a clear, distinct purpose

decisions.decision: browser_find_text folds into browser_find_element as mode text: one locate tool, two modalities - role+name resolves a centred anti-stale handle; a plain text resolves viewport rects in the same space a screenshot uses; the handle is the only click currency.

source.ref: catalog descriptions of 2026-11-19: find_element returns the handle and box, measured from the node at the click; find_text returns each match with a viewport rect in the same space a screenshot uses - one page, two lookups, overlapping purpose
source.also: https://www.anthropic.com/research/writing-tools-for-agents - tools should have a clear, distinct purpose; overlapping tools distract

decisions.decision: Tool names are not renamed; the documentation is fixed to resolve to the live names - the guide and the README carry two generations of names today, and every unrecorded rename widens that gap.

source.ref: browser_get_guide output of 2026-11-19: recipes say portal, front, captcha, click; its own sideEffects block names browser_check_gate, browser_focus_window, wallet_hold_price; 1.6.52.md:12 records the #312 rename that produced generation-2 without rewriting the guide or README

decisions.decision: Every tool description reads at two sentences plus a pointer to the guide topic that carries the detail; refusal semantics, input contracts and side effects stay verbatim; the current catalog measures 3,877 words (about 5,293 description tokens), browser_read_page at 248 words.

source.ref: https://www.anthropic.com/research/writing-tools-for-agents - tool descriptions are loaded into the agent context and steer tool-calling behaviour; context is limited, so every description competes with the task for the same window
source.also: catalog measurement 2026-11-19 (45 tools): descriptions sum to 3,877 words, 21,159 characters

decisions.decision: browser_get_guide gains a topic bukti teks vs gambar - when a measured text read is enough proof and when a picture is mandatory - and every recipe names exact catalog tools with no short aliases.

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "screenshot masih sering digunakan? read page kenapa jarang digunakan?" - the guide pairs recipe Prove it worked (browser_screenshot plus browser_read_page) with refusals that say a tool that reports success is not proof, so image proof is the only proof the server prescribes today

decisions.decision: browser_intercept_picker restores the native picker by itself (TTL or end of the drive); a suppressed picker never survives an abandoned drive, and the next call names how long the picker has been suppressed.

source.ref: catalog description of 2026-11-19: forgetting to disable leaves later Upload clicks silent; guide sideEffects: changes whether the native file picker appears on this tab - a documented silent-failure mode, not a measured incident count

decisions.decision: browser_console is not added until one recorded incident exists that it would have solved; an empty slot in the catalog is not filled by an honest guess.

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "harus ada bukti atau source yang valid bisa dari internet bisa dari user atau performa yang tercatat" - no JS-error-blind incident is recorded anywhere in the repo; the candidate does not pass the evidence gate

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "harus ada bukti atau source yang valid bisa dari internet bisa dari user atau performa yang tercatat" - no such recording exists; the only recorded screenshot measurements are scale conversions

decisions.decision: docs/decisions.json accepts source kind recorded (file:line of the performance that records the decision) beside user, internet and repo; tests/tooling/decisions.test.ts carries the new kind and names what a recorded source points at.

decisions.decision: No tool is split: browser_read_page is not divided into peek/full and browser_run_steps stays one burst primitive - a split would double the catalog this mandate was just told to shrink, while scoping parameters do the work inside one tool.

decisions.decision: Every tool call that throws at the dispatch point is recorded append-only in $OPERA_AGENT_HOME/tool-failures.jsonl with the tool, the error code, the message and the time; the record never throws into the caller and is capped at 2 MB by keeping the newest 1000 lines.

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "buat ini ya log untuk tools yang error atau buggy sama feedback juga" - a failure that the answer cannot carry into the next session survives on the machine instead of vanishing

decisions.decision: The log is read with navego failures (counts by tool and code, the recent failures, every note) and never leaves the machine; the owner machine is the sink, not a server; deleting the file is always safe - it is an observation channel, not a ledger.

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "log untuk tools yang error atau buggy" - the observation stays local and deletable; nothing is uploaded anywhere

decisions.decision: The calling agent leaves the suggestion behind with navego feedback <tool> <note> - one append-only line tied to the tool, surfaced beside the failure counts; that is how an agent that uses a tool and sees it break leaves the fix idea where the maintainer will find it without a server round trip.

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "supaya ai bisa kasih saran perbaikan saat menggunakan tools" - the feedback path ships as a CLI command an agent shell can append; the catalog is not touched

decisions.decision: No new MCP catalog tool is introduced for feedback reporting; the feedback channel is the CLI (navego feedback), not a 46th tool - the frozen tool surface stays as it is, and a catalog tool awaits the same recorded-evidence gate as any addition, the rule applied to browser_console in D63.

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "buat ini" - the mandate authorises the capability, and D63 applies to its shape: no catalog slot without a recorded need that only the catalog can serve

decisions.decision: browser_focus_window is deleted; no tool in the catalog can move any window to the foreground. The drive runs in the background; window state is answered by browser_status (which names the browser in front), and the only remaining front path is the session-level guard in local/focus-guard.ts - it restores the session own window when the page cannot hear input, is not agent-callable, and fires only on the session word of minimized.

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "iya hapus aja yng focus window buat semua bisa berjalan di latar belakang" - the tool existed only to bring a window to the front; the owner wants the drive invisible
source.also: recorded: local/focus-guard.ts documents the session-level restore the agent cannot reach

decisions.decision: browser_screenshot always answers: when the compositor has no frame for the tab (a locked screen, a minimized window, a hidden tab), the driver retries with captureBeyondViewport clipped to the current viewport top, and the answer names the road - compositor or beyondviewport. Nothing is ever brought to the foreground (D73).

source.ref: user 2026-11-19: "yang screenshot fix supaya bisa screenshot di latar belakang" - the live drive hit "Unable to capture screenshot" on a backgrounded tab
source.also: recorded: local/observe.ts capture() - compositor road first, captureBeyondViewport fallback, scope D73 forbids the foreground path
